core.subject: Mode Comparison -- divergence tree showing how different synthesis modes produce different decisions from the same analysis
objects: {{MODE_DECISIONS}} -- per-mode decision statement and most determinative perspective
{{CONVERGENCE_POINTS}} -- decisions all compared modes reached identically
{{DIVERGENCE_POINTS}} -- pivot points where modes produced different outcomes
{{KEY_CHOICE}} -- the underlying values/priorities question the user is actually deciding
notes: {{MODE_SENSITIVITY}} -- Low (all converge) / Medium (agree on direction, differ on scope) / High (fundamentally different decisions)
{{MODES_COMPARED}} -- list of modes included in the comparison
constraints: All text must be legible at 6.5 inch print width
No decorative elements -- every visual element conveys data
